propositions: The attest package (~1770 LOC across 7 files) lacks complete type annotations required by mypy --disallow-untyped-defs.
Function signatures in src/rebar/attest/*.py must be fully annotated without introducing new explicit Any types beyond the two pre-existing trust_root boundary parameters.
After annotation work, mypy src/rebar/attest --disallow-untyped-defs must report zero errors.
The count of explicit Any annotations (verified by grep for ': Any' and '-> Any') must remain exactly 2, confirming no annotation widening was used to satisfy the typing requirement.
